dialogues.text: Beyond the boundaries of the known universe existed a being unlike any other.
A mind capable of understanding the very foundations of reality.
To this being, the universe was an open book.
No single being should hold the knowledge to reshape existence.
The Cosmic Arbiter divided the being's memories into three fragments and scattered them across different dimensions.
Their consciousness wandered into a realm between worlds, where forgotten memories awaited.
Ah... You're finally awake.
Your memories are gone, and even your name has been lost.
Tell me, what should I call you?
Very well. Let us see if we can help you remember the rest.
You dare challenge infinity itself? Your limits will be your downfall.
We'll see about that.
UNAUTHORIZED CHALLENGER DETECTED. INITIATING COMBAT PROTOCOL.
Guess talking isn't an option.
Hello! I'd be happy to assist you. Unfortunately, your request for the memory fragment has been denied.
That's a very long way of saying no.
What?! Impossible! My calculations were flawless! How could I have miscalculated?!
Guess I found the flaw in your calculations!
No! That shouldn't have happened! I accounted for every reaction! What went wrong?!
Guess your calculations were off.
ERROR! ERROR! This outcome is impossible! How did you bypass my system?!
Have you tried turning yourself off and on again?
Witness infinity!
Missile deployed!
Reality.exe: Terminated!
Now, it's my turn!
Power, awaken!
Remember my power!
Behold my true self!
Thank you for your input. It has been disregarded.
Wow. Very professional of you.
The three memory fragments gathered and formed a mirror.
I was created from the part of you that refused to forget. Now that you remember who you are, my purpose has finally been fulfilled.
Until we meet again.
You have walked this path countless times. And each time, I have brought you back to the beginning.
Then perhaps it's time someone questioned that balance.
TO BE CONTINUED...
